verdicts.reason: A: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker is cut off from the headline and floats over the button. The can is shrunk to an unrecognisable sliver, and the three-line body copy and legal text are both tiny. Still, the spacing is consistent and nothing collides. B has the same problems, and its 'Shop Sale' button sits right against the 'Ends Sunday' legal block, which leaves the right side cramped and looks like a collision. Its kicker also crowds the top edge of the button, so A is the less bad resize.
